hypothesis: Matched N=64 reference arm (fresh seeds 62-64, e in [0, 0.5], 4 layers, d_model=64, best-of-5 controls, 10-step checkpoints). It is paired with an N=256 arm on the same seeds to replicate the e<=0.5 delay seen on seeds 56-58. accel_step forms persistently (first checkpoint after which the margin stays >= required_margin at every later checkpoint, read from the per-checkpoint trajectory, not formed_at_step) within steps 70-100, and the half-final-margin step is within steps 50-90.
expected_if_true: In all 3 seeds the persistent 0.1-bar formation step read from the trajectory is in [70, 100], and the first checkpoint reaching half the run's final accel_step margin is in [50, 90]. These per-seed values are the reference for the paired N=256 arm.
expected_if_false: In at least 2 of 3 seeds the persistent 0.1-bar step falls outside [70, 100] or the half-final step falls outside [50, 90], meaning the N=64 reference itself is not stable across seeds.
